communes: São João Das Lampas E Terrugem

blurb.text: A coastal area in Sintra where vines grow in sand behind dunes. Phylloxera never took hold in the sand, so these vines are planted ungrafted. Red Colares from Ramisco is astringent and softens with age, and the whites come from Malvasia.
